items.label: Powerful 7th Gen Intel Core Performance
items.value: The Microsoft Surface Pro 5 Tablet packs an Intel Core i5-7300U processor (up to 3.5GHz) with 8GB RAM and 256GB SSD storage, delivering responsive performance for work and creative tasks

items.label: Premium 2K Touch Display with Included Keyboard
items.value: Featuring a vibrant 12.3-inch 2K touchscreen (2736x1824), this Surface Pro 5 tablet comes with a backlit keyboard for comfortable typing in any lighting conditions

items.label: Ultra-Thin Convertible Design
items.value: At just 0.33 inches thin and 1.7 pounds, the Microsoft Surface Pro 5 laptop offers exceptional portability, easily transforming between tablet and laptop modes

items.label: Complete Connectivity Options
items.value: This Surface Pro tablet includes USB 3.0, Mini DisplayPort, microSD expansion, and Surface Connect port for maximum productivity and peripheral support

items.label: Fully Functional Windows 11 Pro System
items.value: The Microsoft Surface refurbished laptop runs genuine Windows 11 Pro 64-bit (multi-language) with all original features including touchscreen, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity

items.label: Built-in Media
items.value: Backlit Keyboard, Power Adapter/ Cable, laptop
